keyPoints: Gunankhand (factors) wo sankhyaen hain jo kisi sankhya ko poora baant dein — 12 ke gunankhand 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12 hain.
Gunaj (multiples) kisi sankhya ke pahaade hote hain — 5 ke gunaj 5, 10, 15...; har sankhya apne gunankhand se badi ya barabar hoti hai.
Abhajya (prime) sankhya ke sirf do gunankhand hote hain (1 aur khud) — 2, 3, 5, 7, 11; 1 na abhajya hai na bhajya.
Vibhajyata ke niyam tez jaanch dete hain: 2 se (antim ank sam), 3 se (ankon ka yog 3 se vibhajya), 5 se (antim ank 0 ya 5), 10 se (antim ank 0).
Abhajya gunankhand (prime factorisation) me sankhya ko abhajya gunankhandon ke guna ke roop me likhte hain: 36 = 2 x 2 x 3 x 3.
Mahattam samapvartak (HCF) common gunankhandon me sabse bada hai aur laghuttam samapvartya (LCM) common gunajon me sabse chhota — 12 aur 18 ka HCF 6, LCM 36.
Aam galti: 1 ko abhajya samajhna ya 2 ko bhool jana — 2 sabse chhoti aur ekmatra sam abhajya sankhya hai.
